summary: Frontend-only regression for the redesigned We Serve (4 disciplines x 4 plants). Verified navbar dropdown, landing grid, 4 discipline pages, all 16 detail pages, redirects for old/invalid slugs, in-app SPA navigation (no reload), and mobile accordion. All target testids present and reveal opacity resolves to 1. Mobile accordion expands to the 4 disciplines and taps navigate correctly (verified visually via screenshot).
critical_code_review_comments: WeServePage.jsx line 44: the numbering expression `0{i + 1 > 9 ? '' : ''}{i + 1}` always emits '0'+n regardless of branch — harmless (only 4 items) but the ternary is dead code and should be simplified to `0{i + 1}`.

WeServeCategoryPage.jsx: comment '{/* Other categories */}' above <CTA /> is stale; there is no other-categories section here (only in Detail page as 'other-subs'). Consider removing the misleading comment.

Consider adding a data-testid on the mobile menu hamburger and on the accordion toggle button for We Serve to make future Playwright tests less brittle (currently rely on aria-label / class-name matches).
context_for_next_testing_agent: We Serve now: 4 disciplines (mechanical-work, civil-work, electrical-work, additional-services) each with 4 plants (cement-plant, power-plant, steel-plant, fertilizer-plant). Data in /app/frontend/src/weServe.js. Old slugs redirect via <Navigate replace> at category and sub levels. Mobile menu 'We Serve' label is a Link to /we-serve; the sibling '+' button (2nd .text-[#c8a25c] button inside .fixed nav) toggles the accordion. When writing selectors, avoid get_by_text('Mechanical Work').first because it matches the hidden desktop dropdown link — scope inside the mobile menu container.
